Retrieves the key of the requested scanner.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
The ID or UUID of the scanner. You can use the default UUID 00000000-
0000-0000-0000-00000000000000000000000000001  to retrieve your
container's current linking key.
scanner_id
required
